Stage 2 of 3 released; stage 3 not yet released.
- S1 configuration: yaml timeout_ms 2500 (config/payments-api.yaml:7) and pool max_size 48 (:11) are superseded by release-notes-6.25.3-646f.md:5 (timeout 800) and :17 (pool 10). Deployed at deploys.log:1, 08:14:28Z.
- S1 symptom: 95 "tax-engine timed out after 800ms" errors in stage-1/logs/payments-api.log:153-207 and later. There were only 7 db pool wait WARNs (lines 175, 204).
- TLS, disk and DNS are ruled out.
- S2: on-call mitigation in stage-2/deploy/changes.log stopped the timeouts. Ingress still returns 503s with a different error, likely DB_POOL_EXHAUSTED at pool 10.
- Next: read stage-2 changes.log, UPDATE, logs, metrics csv and notes. Then advance to stage 3. Cite symptom, current-value record and release-notes:17.
